doc.title: Tom Porrello interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 6, 2023

title: Life on Kenton's bus and no drugs
summary: Few hotel nights, 500-mile jumps, freezing cold buses, and Kenton's strict stance against drug use.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: No it didn’t matter at all. But I say like watching those guys get on the band bus I said oh man I’ve got to do that someday. And I got to do it and then that’s the hardest part of the job is that band bus you know. With Stan Kenton you know I was with the mellophone band and playing lead trumpet with four mellophones, five trumpets and five trombones is kind of a chore. But it was a fun chore. But jeez, the bus, you know we had such a large band with Stan Kenton that we couldn’t check in every night you know. We would get to maybe some weeks, three or four nights of a hotel, the rest of the time just riding the bus, getting to the next gig, 500 miles in between things. Run in, shave, shower, put the suit on, run back. Stan always kept the buses freezing cold — pull on a winter coat even though it was summertime, and go on to the next one. Then those were kind of tough, kind of rough things to do. But I wouldn’t trade it for anything.
Why did Stan keep the buses cold?

I don’t know. He was always warm. He would get on the bus and — we were — so I’d been, I was living in New York at the time. And I bought a heavy, heavy winter coat and that’s what we had — we rode in the bus with those things on and he had the bus down to like 62 or 60. Really cold. Sometimes colder. And sometimes he’d open the window.
Yeah. And the buses back then weren’t exactly like the buses now either. They were pretty B flat.
Pretty B flat. Did you — I would imagine that bad habits — I’ll just use that term — probably occurred because of that life.

It was a tough life but I can speak for the bands I’ve been with, but okay I’ll stick with Stan for a minute. Stan didn’t put up with any drug use or anything like that. He was very fussy about that. If he found somebody he would send them off. So they didn’t have a chance to get into that. But some of the other bands they allowed that.
